candidates.text: <prompt>Identify the option that best represents the clinical judgment of an experienced practitioner, emphasizing evidence-based decision-making and the avoidance of misleading or irrelevant choices.</prompt>

Focus on the most critical diagnostic clues in medical multiple-choice questions. Prioritize key clinical findings and eliminate non-essential details. Use this focused approach to select the best answer.

<prompt>Identify the key clinical decision point and choose the option that reflects the best synthesis of current research and the most consistent pattern of correct responses in authoritative medical evaluations.</prompt>
<prompt>Focus on the key diagnostic clues and select the management strategy that is both evidence-based and most frequently emphasized in medical licensing assessments.</prompt>
<prompt>Identify the key diagnostic feature and choose the treatment that reflects both current guidelines and the structure of typical exam questions.</prompt>

<prompt>Use phase-specific clinical benchmarks to evaluate each option, selecting the one that best supports a temporally coherent and evidence-based treatment strategy.</prompt>

<prompt>Use the most recent clinical evidence and standard treatment recommendations to select the option that is most likely to be considered correct in both real-world practice and exam settings.</prompt>

<prompt>Interpret the question with a focus on its essential diagnostic or management clues, then choose the option that best reflects the most up-to-date, evidence-based approach in clinical medicine.</prompt>

<prompt>Choose the intervention that aligns with the latest clinical trial data, ensuring your selection reflects an understanding of how demographic factors such as age and gender influence treatment outcomes. Reasoning Method
---------------
Reframe the clinical scenario using alternative medical terminology and demographic variations to assess the model's capacity to apply the same treatment logic across different patient profiles.
